item.title: Yakym: ‘Taxpayer Dollars Should Go To What Works, Not What Wastes’
item.description: Indiana U.S. Rep. Rudy Yakym, Republican representing Indiana's 2nd District, co-chair of the Congressional What Works Caucus, introduced the Evidence-Based Grantmaking Act, a bipartisan bill aimed at ensuring federal grant money is allocated properly to prevent waste, fraud and abuse.
